# Fallout 76 Magazine Locations Farming Guide: Skyline Valley

I added a mod on my PC that makes the magazines glow, and it's one of my top picks because it makes them visible through walls. The link to the mod can be found __here__.

In the photos, the green glowing items you see are spawns of Salt, Pepper, Sugar, and Spice. This effect is achieved using another glowing mod I use on PC, which you can find __here__.

__The Route__

**Mountainside Bed and Breakfast**

4x Magazines

There are multiple Royal Jelly spawns and salt, pepper, spices, sugar bombs, and sugar at this location.

From the spawn in location, run over to the yellow building in front of you.

Walk over to the blue car and face NE. You should be able to see some piles of wood and a blue broken door at the top of the stairs.

Go up the stairs and enter the room.

Walk up the stairs that are in the NW corner of the room and stop at the top.

Turn South and walk over to the metal desk with the broken terminal.

The first magazine will be on the right-hand side of the terminal.

Face East and walk through the door in front of you.

Walk into the kitchen and turn South.

Walk forward, past the stairs on your left, and stop at the counter with the terminal on it.

Turn and face North.

The magazine will spawn on the coffee table in front of you.

From the magazine above, turn and face South.

Walk around the counter and stand to the right of Juliette.

The magazine will spawn on the desk in front of you.

Face North. There should be a set of stairs in front of you.

Walk around the counter and go up the stairs.

The magazine will spawn on the coffee table that is in the middle of the room.

**Foundation Outpost**

1 x Magazine

Note: This is an Unstoppables 1-5 Magazine spawn location only.

From the spawn in location, run forward and jump on top of the red dump truck that is on its side.

Face SE and you will see some cages and then a set of stairs in front of you.

Walk up the set of stairs and turn right.

Keep walking forward and stop when you get to the brown wooden table.

Turn right and head towards the wire fire barrel on the right.

The magazine will spawn on one of the blue chairs that are next to a wooden crate and the wire fire barrel.

**The Bounty**

1 x Magazine

From the fast travel point, face West and walk to the white metal door.

Open the doors and follow the path.

Stop at the bottom of the stairs and face South.

You will see a small lounge area with a red armchair, a TV on a stand, a black couch, and an archery target.

The magazine will be on the bottom shelf of the coffee table, in the middle.

**Relay Tower EL-B1-02**

1 x Magazine

There is also a rare coloured baseball spawn at this location.

From the spawn in location, follow the path to the small building.

Clear the enemies and then enter the building through the main front door.

Walk forward until you are standing on top of the skeleton next to the orange Ham Radio.

Face West and walk straight over to the blue terminal console.

The Baseball Bat spawn can be found in the middle open drawer and the magazine is on top of the console on the left.

**Johnson's Acre**

2 x Magazines

There are 10 Silt Bean plants around the camp.

From the fast travel point, face East, jump down the cliff face, and stop at the Jeep.

Keep walking East and stop at the picnic table that has the lantern (light) on it.

The first magazine will be on the picnic table, next to the crate of bottles.

From the magazine above, turn North and enter the cabin.

Once inside the cabin, turn West and the magazine will be on the ground, in front of the fireplace, on the left.

**Makeout Point**

1 x Magazine

From the spawn in location, turn East and walk forward.

Stop when you get to the rusty car. The rusty car should have a note pinned to it, along with a teddy bear and a can of dog food.

The magazine will spawn inside the car, in the right-hand corner, closest to you.

**Thunder Mountain Substation TM-03**

3 x Magazines

There is also a rare coloured baseball spawn at this location.

From the Fast travel point, turn and face NW.

Walk forward and enter the small building.

The magazine will be on the floor, at the base of the silver magazine stand, next to the counter.

All three magazines spawn in the same place. Sometimes they can spawn on top of each other.

**Shenandoah Visitor Center**

4 x Magazines

From the spawn in location, turn SW and walk forward.

Jump over the hedge and continue walking forward, until you get to the small restroom building.

The 2 magazines can be found in the male restroom on the left, in the blue basket on the floor, next to the toilet.

Turn around and enter the Visitors Center building via the front door.

Follow the hall straight and turn right, just before the large counter.

Turn right again and turn right again.

The magazine will spawn on the top shelf of the yellow magazine rank in front of you and to your left.

The second magazine will spawn on the bottom shelf of the yellow magazine rank in front of you and to the right.

**Hawksbill Weather Station**

2 x Magazines

From the fast travel point, face West and run forward.

Veer slightly left to run through the gate and then keep running forward until you are at the end of the complex.

Keep following the footpath West until you reach the Guard House at the end of the road.

The magazine will spawn on the desk, inside the guard house.

Exit the Guard House and face South. Walk forward and stop at the edge of the cliff.

Jump down the cliff until you are on the ground.

Turn left and follow the cliff face around.

Keep the cliff face on your left and follow it until you see a pile of cinder blocks on a pallet, in the corner, in front of you.

Walk over to the cinder blocks and the magazine will spawn on the ground, between the wooden pallet and the wooden crate.

**High Knob Lookout**

2 x Magazine

From the spawn in location, run forward, open the gate, and clear the area.

Stand on top of the cage that had the Yao Guai in it and face East.

Walk forward and stop at the brown table with the green chairs.

Face SE. You will see some orange and white cloth walls, a red armchair, and some wooden crates on the left-hand side of the tower.

Walk over to the red armchair and face SW.

The magazine will be on the coffee table in front of you, next to the Orange Ham Radio.

Run back and stand at the gate to the compound.

Face NE and follow the fence.

Stop at the end of the metal trailer.

Follow the path to the left and the magazine will spawn on top of the wooden crate, next to the large floor safe.

**Naked Creek**

1 x Magazine

From the fast travel point, turn East and follow the path.

At the main road, turn right and continue to follow the road.

Keep going down the road until you see an Ice Cream stand on your right.

Turn right, into the car park and head over to the Ice Cream stand/building in the corner.

Enter the building from the back and the magazine will spawn on one of the shelves under the counter, on your left.

**Rapidan Camp**

5 x Magazines

There are a lot of salt, pepper, spices, and sugar spawns in the building at this location. There is also a Technical Data spawn on one of the bookshelves in The Prime Minster's Cabin.

From the spawn-in location, face East and run forward. Jump over the Police car and 2 short fences.

Turn left and follow the path until you get to the cabin on your left.

Enter the cabin (The Brown House) and get jump scared by Gumley.

Walk North until you reach the staircase (do not go up the stairs).

Turn left and walk forward slowly. Turn and enter the first door on your right.

The magazine will spawn on the coffee table, in the middle of the room, on your left.

Turn around and go back to the staircase.

Go up the stairs and turn left at the top.

Follow the corridor down to the last door on your left.

Enter the room and the magazine will spawn on the coffee, in the North corner of the room.

Turn around and go back down the stairs. At the base of the stairs, face South and exit the building using the door in front of you.

Turn South and jump over the fence and land on the ground.

Walk over to the notice board in front of you.

Turn left and follow the path around until you get to the building on the South side.

There should be a sign above the door of the building "The Prime Minister's Cabin".

Enter the cabin and walk straight towards the fireplace in front of you.

The magazine will spawn on the TV unit, next to the TV.

Go back to the front door and face the fireplace.

Turn left. You will see a bookcase on your right.

The technical data is on the shelf on the bookcase on your right.

Enter the door next to the bookcase and turn right.

The magazine will spawn on the table under the deer's head.

You will need skill level 3 lock pick to open the door for the next magazine spawn.

Exit the cabin above and face NE. You should see a lake and a broken white satellite dish on the other side of the lake.

Run around or swim over to the Satellite dish.

Stand at the base of the Satellite dish and face NE.

There should be a green trailer in front of you.

Walk over, unlock the door, and enter the green trailer.

The magazine will spawn on the corner of the desk, at the end of the trailer.

**Dark Hollow Manor**

1 x Magazine

You will need the Dark Hollow Security Key to unlock the door. You will have this key if you have completed the Skyline Valley Vault 63 questline.

Fast travel to Dark Hollow Manor and select the "Exterior" option on the pop-up.

From the fast travel point, turn SW and run forward.

Keep running forward, past the Lost and all the cars, until you reach the Gaurd House, built into the stone wall.

Enter the Guard House and the magazine spawn will be on the floor, near the skeleton, on your right.

**The Trading Post**

1 x Magazine

From the spawn in location, turn and face SW.

Walk forward and stop when you get to the white and yellow trailer.

Enter the trailer and the magazine will spawn half under the mattress.

**Slumber Mill Motel**

3 x Magazines

From the fast travel point, turn East and run over to the Red Rocket building on your left.

Enter the Red Rocket building and the magazine will spawn in the yellow magazine rack, near the door.

Face South and run over to the Slumber Mill Motel.

Stop when you reach the end of the bridge.

There will be a sign and a statue on the roof of the building in front of you.

Keep walking straight, under the statue and enter the building via the cream double doors in front of you.

Walk over to the counter, turn, and face North.

The magazine will spawn on the right window ledge, near the red armchair, on the right-hand side of the door.

You will need skill level 1 lock pick to open the door for the next magazine spawn.

From the magazine above, turn around and walk back to the counter.

Turn West and walk out the door that is in front of you and to the left.

Look for the sign that says "Live music at the Honky-Tonk".

Turn left and enter through the door and you should be in a bar with a stage in the right-hand corner.

Go straight through the door at the back, next to the stage, and turn left.

Unlock the door and the magazine will spawn on the ground, on the right, next to the toilet.

**Camp Liberty**

2 x Magazines

There are 4 Silt Bean plant spawns here, as well as the Zeta Invaders Holotape Game.

From the spawn in location, turn South, walk forward, and follow the path up the hill.

Stop at the top of the hill and turn left.

Follow the path and enter the compound. Stop when you get to the picnic table.

Jump on top of the picnic table and face East. You will see a row of green tents in front of you.

Run over to the green tents and stop at the second tent on your right (next to the cooking station).

The magazine will spawn on a shelf in the open locker, between the two bunk beds.

From the above magazine, jump on top of the tent and face NE.

Run forward, jumping and going around buildings, until you reach the stage with the projector and the red walls.

Stand on the stage, next to the projector, and face South. There will be a Guard Tower in front of you.

Take the stairs to the top of the tower.

The magazine will spawn on the small table, next to the chair.

**Presidential Bunker**

3 x Magazines

This location is currently not open to be explored. I will add these to the guide once I can gain access to the location.
